rows.note: This is the all-purpose pattern when something progressively becomes bigger or takes on a quality over time.

example.english: The box will grow bigger and bigger.
example.jyutping: go3 soeng1 jyut6 lei4 jyut6 daai6 laa3

rows.note: Use this for a person or living thing growing up and maturing, rather than merely becoming larger.

example.traditional: 啲細路仔好快就長大喇。
example.jyutping: di1 sai3 lou6 zai2 hou2 faai3 zau6 zoeng2 daai6 laa3

rows.note: Use this when someone cultivates or grows plants, crops, or vegetables.

example.english: We grow vegetables on the rooftop.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 hai2 tin1 toi4 zung3 coi3

rows.note: Use this for plants growing naturally in a place or for shoots and buds sprouting or appearing.

example.english: Moss can grow in damp corners.
example.jyutping: ciu4 sap1 ge3 coeng4 gok3 wui5 sang1 cing1 toi4
